name: Fujigamine Nazuna
source:
She is a teacher with a friendly atmosphere and is loved by her students. He tends to leave the solution of problems to the students and is not very helpful in times of emergency.

She is in charge of “Shiro no Koshika-tei”, but she does not seem to be very useful here either.

She is in charge of ancient Japanese literature.

[From [url=https://www.pulltop.com/gp07/02_chara12-01.html]official site[/url]]
